bridgeRouteRisk.summary: apyUSD is an ERC-4626 wrapper over canonical Ethereum apxUSD. Ethereum is the native Lock/Release home; Base is a Chainlink CCIP Burn/Mint representation whose token-level mint and burn are restricted to pool 0xed23fc184a3fe5d12ca92ca4f5cefa640decf21d and whose 100,000,000-token destination cap is separately governed by the Base AccessManager/Safe. The Chainlink directory also lists BNB Chain and Solana representations, but they are not authored in this coin's contracts[] and therefore remain explicit route-coverage follow-up rather than an assertion that Base is the only representation.

protocols.name: Chainlink CCIP (Cross-Chain Token standard)
protocols.note: The official directory lists Ethereum as Lock/Release home and Base, BNB Chain, and Solana as Burn/Mint representations. Only the Ethereum and Base deployments are authored in this coin's catalog, so BNB/Solana control coverage is deferred pending catalog reconciliation.

routes.reviewNote: At Ethereum block 25770413, asset() returned apxUSD 0x98A878b1Cd98131B271883B390f68D2c90674665, paused() was false, totalAssets() was nonzero, and the UUPS implementation was 0xfd616567ecc1607f61073951a1e822f7315bb112. No CCIP pool or LayerZero endpoint surface was found on the canonical wrapper; its shares mint natively against deposited apxUSD under the Ethereum AccessManager/3-of-6 Safe path. The Chainlink directory identifies Ethereum as the Lock/Release home deployment.

At Base block 50063823, getCCIPPool() returned 0xed23fc184a3fe5d12ca92ca4f5cefa640decf21d; the pool's getToken() returned this wrapper and owner() returned the Apyx 3/6 Safe 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2. The verified BridgedApyxToken source gates mint(), burn(), and burnFrom() to this pool and enforces a destination supply cap, so this is a CCIP representation against the Ethereum deployment rather than independent native issuance.

The official Chainlink CCIP directory identifies this BNB Chain apyUSD deployment as a Burn/Mint representation of canonical Ethereum apyUSD; the token address and 18-decimal precision match the authored catalog.

The official Chainlink CCIP directory identifies this Solana apyUSD deployment as a Burn/Mint representation of canonical Ethereum apyUSD; the token address and 6-decimal precision match the authored catalog.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Base block 50063823, getToken() returned the authored Base apyUSD representation and owner() returned the Apyx Safe; the pool is the CCIP route's token-side mint/burn controller.
routeChecks.caps: The verified BridgedApyxToken source gates mint(), burn(), and burnFrom() to the stored CCIP pool and rejects minting above the 100,000,000 apyUSD destination supply cap. Approximately 99,386,203.0065 apyUSD remained at Base block 50063823.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The pool supplies bridge mint/burn capability only; AccessManager and Safe controls for setCCIPPool, setCCIPAdmin, upgrades, cap changes, pause, and unpause are recorded separately.

controls.capDescription: Base destination supply cap: 100,000,000 apyUSD; the pool cannot raise it.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50063823, pool 0xed23fc184a3fe5d12ca92ca4f5cefa640decf21d returned token 0x2c271ddf484ac0386d216eb7eb9ff02d4dc0f6aa and owner 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2. The deployed pool bytecode was 13,813 bytes; the destination token reported a 100,000,000 cap with approximately 99,386,203.0065 remaining.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: Role 25 governs setCCIPPool and setCCIPAdmin for the Base representation; the CCIP pool remains a separate route-level controller.
routeChecks.caps: Role 24 governs setSupplyCap with a 259200-second delay; the current destination cap is 100,000,000 apyUSD.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Role 25 governs upgradeToAndCall with a 604800-second delay; role 21 pauses immediately and role 22 unpauses after 14400 seconds.

controls.capDescription: Base representation cap is changeable by delayed role 24; this is bridge-route administration, not native Ethereum issuance.
controls.evidence: At Base blocks 50063823 and 50063992, AccessManager 0x8afde6a90d2396a64eb97e8e69e7548289f78a1d mapped setCCIPPool, setCCIPAdmin, and upgradeToAndCall to Safe-held role 25 with a 604800-second delay; setSupplyCap mapped to role 24 with a 259200-second delay; pause used role 21 with no delay; unpause used role 22 with a 14400-second delay. The same Safe returned threshold 3, six owners, version 1.4.1, no enabled modules, and no guard.
